notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Budoka Gardener.
Budoka Gardener does not have summoning sickness.
You control eight or less lands.
description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.

uses.name: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life
